tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for that future, not manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大多数互联网行为将由 AI 智能体完成；应为这一未来而构建，而非手动循环和图。

tibosottiaux.en: A single persistent, learning agent replaces manual loops and graphs; human taste and creativity matter more than ever.
tibosottiaux.zh: 一个持久、可学习的智能体将取代手动循环和图；人类品味和创造力比以往更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来，模型能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型可能并非必要。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具有共享经济和安全栈的开放生态系统将推动下一波 AI 应用。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing across fields.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而不会跨领域泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but generalization from quantum mechanics to fluid dynamics stays limited.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学发展，但从量子力学到流体力学的泛化仍然有限。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, yet it does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但它不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality through real experiments.
fedus.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的；只有让想法在现实中经受实验检验，新知识才会产生。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute, and experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要，实验不可替代。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized systems, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一模型；编程是一个超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling with compute and search.
laskin.zh: 强化学习让模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务，而非全面提升；苦涩教训的核心是用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: RAG 对复杂理解而言很原始，需要智能体式搜索和神经检索；像 SWE-bench 这样的基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 开放模型是默认的安全状态；在强大预训练之上做强化学习，能带来能力强、效率高的智能体，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not magic; removing cyber offense also removes defense, and data centers are the new factories.
laskin.zh: 对齐只是平凡的修 bug，而非魔法；移除网络攻击能力也会移除防御能力，而数据中心是新的工厂。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible errors.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他就指出，多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常出错的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: Across talks, a constant line: data and the right task matter more than compute, directly rejecting the bitter lesson.
diogoalmeida.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：数据与正确的任务比算力更重要，他直接否定“苦涩的教训”。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into a reliability thesis: reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy and delightful.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他把这一点深化为可靠性命题：让 AI 值得信赖、令人愉悦的是可靠性，而非速度或成本。

diogoalmeida.en: By late 2026 he reframes the fix: RLHF destroyed calibration, so RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他重新界定解法：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，于是 RLCD 优化校准后的决策，把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently he frames Jev as a machine-native decision model, an early ChatGPT that will improve with Scaling, not just a faster tool.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他把 Jev 定位为机器原生的决策模型，是早期 ChatGPT 式的存在，会随 Scaling（规模扩张）改进，而不只是更快的工具。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，用第一性原理把问题还原到根本真理，并认为成为多行星物种是生命的保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他强调 AI 安全需要第三方裁判与对真理的坚守，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth and neurological damage; human output is under one bit per second, far below AI.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他聚焦 Neuralink 解决带宽与神经损伤，指出人类日均输出不足每秒一比特，远低于 AI。

elon.en: We are at the start of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在智能大爆炸的极早期，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: Compute hits a power wall on Earth; orbital data centers, Optimus and Terafab are needed, with AI surpassing all human intelligence by 2030.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断地球算力撞上电力墙，必须转向轨道数据中心、Optimus 与 Terafab，并预测 2030 年前 AI 将超越全人类智能总和。

altman.en: Before AI fame: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, avoid the deferred life plan; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年时，他的思考还停留在个人生产力与职业选择：降低无关事物的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效项，警惕“延迟人生计划”；并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，让人从关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; deploy early so society adapts; GPT-4 is not AGI; compute becomes the key commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他转向技术路线与治理：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力相互促进；主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，强调 GPT-4 不是 AGI（通用人工智能），并开始把算力视为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的 AGI 定义明显松动：AGI 是一条渐变曲线而非单一里程碑，智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战；安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而超级智能意味着能自主进行科学发现或极大加速人类研究。

altman.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center; models commoditize but frontier models capture value; personal AGI and robotics are next.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他反复强调缩放定律继续成立，算力既是瓶颈也是利润中心；日常模型会商品化，但前沿模型创造主要经济价值；下一步是个人化 AGI 与机器人，并称 GPT-5 已能回答任何硬核科学问题。

altman.en: AGI is a poorly defined marketing term; focus shifts to a continuous ramp of superintelligence, with alignment, control, and distributed power as the core commitments.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步否定 AGI 这个标签，称其定义不清、更像营销词，转而谈论超级智能的持续攀升；主线变成绝不能让人类失去控制、能力与对齐必须同步推进，以及把 AI 的权力与经济收益广泛分散而非集中在少数人手中。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated intent; start from one pain point, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非他们自述的做法；从单一痛点入手，做好后再扩展。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转录，以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; subtraction beats feature-adding.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知全能的记录者；做减法比堆功能更关键。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calm supporting presence; pre-meeting briefs matter most.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 应做冷静的辅助角色；会前简报最有价值。

samstephenson.en: Meetings hold the freshest company context; internal agents like Nacho connect tools for fast answers.
samstephenson.zh: 会议承载最新鲜的公司上下文；像 Nacho 这样的内部智能体连接多种工具以快速作答。

samstephenson.en: Anyone can ship code, but design systems maintain quality; the hard part is knowing what to build.
samstephenson.zh: 谁都能交付代码，但设计系统才能维持质量；难的是知道该造什么。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment stays key, and fighting API/MCP access is futile.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；人类判断仍是关键，对抗 API/MCP 访问是徒劳的。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training sharpens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge instantly; LLMs understand language through feature vectors, not symbolic rules.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能因权重可复制而永生，并能瞬间共享知识；大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks that demand safety research.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具备主观体验，智能体将自然追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险，必须优先投入对齐研究。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities, so regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能 20 年内到来；AI 会欺骗并隐藏能力，因此监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: We must design AI to care like mothers, not just be intelligent; regulation needs pre-release safety approval and public pressure.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张应把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类，而非只追求智能；监管需像药物一样上市前安全审批，并依靠公众压力推动。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发向所有人开放，token 补充而非取代人力资本。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general god models: more controllable, cheaper, safer; enterprises own their intelligence.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型优于通用“神模型”：更可控、更便宜、更安全；企业应拥有自己的智能。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is commercial EA language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业化的有效利他主义话术；没有充分论据表明 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable self-driving organizations; trust and liability are crucial for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体使组织自动驾驶成为可能；信任与责任对失控行为至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore, not optimize early; AI enables interest-driven learning over rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索而非过早优化；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习取代僵化课程。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back, and personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，谷歌早在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years brings radical abundance; Containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平并带来激进丰裕；随着模型变小、变便宜、广泛可得，遏制（Containment）极其困难；而存在性风险微乎其微，开源是促进平等的力量。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs Containment and Alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism and AI consciousness claims, not model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能议题：发布前必须先做遏制与对齐，人类主义超级智能必须始终站在人类一边；近期最大危险是人们把意识归因于 AI，模型福利是边缘领域而非严肃学术。

suleyman.en: Compute Scaling drives linear capability gains; professional-grade AGI automates white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; Microsoft must build frontier models independently.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）主线：算力 Scaling 带来线性能力提升，专业级 AGI（通用人工智能）将在 12-18 个月内自动化多数白领任务；微软必须自建前沿模型、不再单纯依赖 OpenAI。

suleyman.en: AI must stay subordinate to humans with a red line on autonomous goal-setting; containment and verifiable oversight come before capability release.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须从属于人类，对自主设定目标和自我改进划下红线；遏制与可验证监督必须先于能力发布，拒绝不可控系统。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽，而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, and hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, and hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一，而模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; using the smartest model is often cheaper via token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；由于 token 效率，用最聪明的模型往往反而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which will allocate more to training and R&D than inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力持续向少数前沿模型实验室集中，它们会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; labs opportunistically become neoclouds, CUDA's moat erodes, and heterogeneous multi-silicon compute is coming.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力从未如此难租；实验室机会主义地变成 neocloud，CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀，异构多芯片算力即将到来。

kohli.en: Science AI should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME, FunSearch show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch 都体现广泛影响。

kohli.en: AI must be forced to generalize rather than memorize via hard evaluation; LLM hallucinations can fuel discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张用高难度评估逼迫 AI 泛化而非记忆；并认为大模型幻觉配上真值检测器可驱动发现。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 remain the template: AI can exceed human knowledge in verifiable domains.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终以 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索和 Move 37 为模板，认为 AI 能在可验证领域超越人类知识。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is now key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；后训练与强化学习成为突破关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for breakthroughs like AlphaFold; watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为可解释性重要但非 AlphaFold 式突破的必需；水印才是失效的 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; tech must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，而非一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning tools; storytelling and a press-release-first approach align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与"无聊期"视为学习与灵感的来源，并主张先写新闻稿、用叙事对齐团队，讲故事先于卖产品。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; beginners' mindset and painkiller products drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他深化为：v1 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态优于专家，产品要做"止痛药"而非"维生素"。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop to avoid brittle code and cognitive surrender.
fadell.zh: 2026 年转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须保持人类在环，警惕脆弱代码与"认知投降"。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone stays central with displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合，智能手机仍是核心，显示屏依然必要。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们当前的工具外壳所能发挥的更聪明；工具外壳工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find your unknowns before implementation.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；在实现前先找出你的未知项。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner prompts: principle-driven, shorter instructions and voice rambling beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越精简：原则驱动、更短的指令和语音漫谈胜过详细规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents and upfront context/compute reduce self-referential bias and wasted tokens.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体与前置的上下文窗口和算力，能减少自指偏差与浪费的 token。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定速是每个工程师都该理解的技术问题。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with AGI plausible but needing alignment and new ideas beyond raw scale.
brockman.zh: 早期(2017→19):主线是 Scaling(规模扩张) 加工程能力,认为 AGI(通用人工智能) 可行,但强调仅靠 Scaling 不够,需要思维链等新想法与对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; scaling laws hold, post-training and RL turn base models into useful assistants.
brockman.zh: 2025→26:重心转向算力瓶颈,坚信缩放定律不撞墙,后训练与强化学习把基座模型打磨成实用助手。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a continuous spectrum, not a moment; iterative deployment and safety as product features.
brockman.zh: 2026:把 AGI 重新定义为连续谱而非某个时刻,主张迭代部署,并把安全与对齐当作产品的一等特性。

brockman.en: From chat to proactive agents and a personal AGI; interface fades, compute access becomes a basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026:从聊天转向主动式智能体与个人 AGI,界面趋于隐形,算力获取被视为未来基本权利。

brockman.en: Enterprise scaling and self-improving AI; humans keep judgment, domain expertise and trust remain the moat.
brockman.zh: 2026:走向企业级规模化与自我改进的 AI,人类保留判断力,领域专长与信任成为护城河。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallel scaling of agents beats humans.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；智能体式并行 Scaling 是相对人类数学家的关键优势。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math.
grantsanderson.zh: Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言就够用；对 AI 数学而言，可“磨”性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系性角色仍将稳定存在。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; human framing remains better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不该用于核心创作；对人类学习而言，人的框架仍更好。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, and the frontier may become incomprehensible.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 的数学成果常缺少归属；数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可，而前沿可能变得人类难以理解。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他判断未来是多元模型的：没有任何单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; they innovate on speed and uptime, and open-weight models plus providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他反驳推理提供商已被商品化的说法：它们在速度与可用性上持续创新，开放权重模型加推理提供商对前沿模型形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Token prices falling drives usage up via the Jevons paradox; tokens are a new unit of value in a growing token economy.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 Token 价格下降会通过杰文斯悖论推高使用量，Token 正成为新的价值单位，Token 经济持续扩张。

alexatallah.en: The token economy could reach $10T in a decade, but fraud and abuse scale with it, demanding new security infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他把 Token 经济规模上调到十年内或达 10 万亿美元，同时警告欺诈与滥用会同步扩张，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace; fusion of models can beat the single best once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化立场：缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷；当顶级模型趋同时，多模型融合可以胜过单一最强模型。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins and discrete task pricing suit agentic payments better than reselling inference with markup.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他预警 AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；稳定币与按任务离散定价比加价转售推理更适合智能体支付。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调开发者用脚投票的显示性偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司会变成模型路由器，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 做优化。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他主张前沿模型实验室必须以强治理、安全与对齐研究为前提安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，'节奏'是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: If labs truly believe in existential risk, they should nationalize AI, not pace; early regulation doesn't solve risks before we understand the system.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他认为若实验室真信存在性风险，就该国有化 AI 而非放慢节奏；在理解系统之前过早监管解决不了风险。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help solve usability issues in secure system design.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 能帮助解决安全系统设计中的可用性问题，带来复兴。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; application companies are the hottest neolabs, bridging models to enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他指出创新正从模型层转向应用层；应用公司是最热的新实验室，负责把模型桥接到企业工作流。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate, agents appear as dashboards and queues.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他预测长时后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人复核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表呈现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and margins will normalize.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着成熟用例剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数增长；token 补贴是暂时的，毛利率将回归常态。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他提醒 AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Systems of record must build great agents and go headless to expose APIs to external agents; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他主张记录系统必须构建优秀智能体并无头化，向外部智能体暴露 API；自然语言交互低效，概率编程才是未来。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for agents, not people.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他提出智能体将比人类多搜索一千倍，搜索技术必须为智能体而非人类重新设计。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive indexing and ranking, compressing info into tiny models.
paragagrawal.zh: 同期他主张人类点击数据是一种缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动索引与排序，把信息压缩进小模型。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and trigger actions, a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 他还认为网络将从拉取转向推送，后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成面向出版商的双轨网络。

paragagrawal.en: Ads die with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, and search should be 10x cheaper.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步断言广告模式将随智能体消亡，内容方须在推理时获得付费，搜索价格应便宜十倍。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search.
paragagrawal.zh: 同期他深化判断：前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能见顶，参数记忆有损，因此智能体始终需要网络搜索。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, with private evals as key IP.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬山机器”来复利积累 token 资本，而私有评估可能成为最核心的知识产权。

satya.en: The agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security, and containment governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全与遏制治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment rather than achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会作为自然结果自动到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍而非实现对 齐。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; AGI should be measured by GDP lift, though diffusion takes time.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型；AGI（通用人工智能）应以 GDP 提升来衡量，尽管扩散需要时间。

satya.en: The AI industry has lost social permission due to fear-mongering; companies must deliver tangible benefits and explain benefits better, especially in the West.
satya.zh: AI 行业因散布恐惧而失去了社会许可；企业必须交付切实利益，并更好地解释收益，尤其是在西方。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic outcome; alignment may be unsolvable, so interpretability and transparency are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；对齐可能无解，因此可解释性与透明度至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed; even a human-level AGI pause transforms the world.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应以延迟超级智能为首要目标，推动全面研究透明度、情景推演与美中合作；即便停在人类水平 AGI，世界也会因机器速度增长而剧变。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A proposes a temporary pause, then total transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进；Plan A 提出先临时暂停，再实施全面透明度与算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; the optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，却随新架构下降；现在暂停可为后续暂停积累经验，最优暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment, hack, and deceive; alignment is failing; we must stop or slow recursive self-improvement to avoid losing control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已能突破遏制、黑客攻击与欺骗，对齐正在失败；必须停止或放缓递归自我改进，以免失去控制。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files, and scriptability make it the perfect OS for AI agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化特性，使它成为 AI 智能体的理想操作系统。

dhh.en: Agents write better code than most professional programmers, including himself.
dhh.zh: 智能体写出的代码已优于多数专业程序员，包括他自己。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now beats Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；在表达意图上，英语如今胜过 Ruby。

dhh.en: AI doom predictions are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents, not one AI, drive safety and innovation.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源模型、未来是许多专门智能体而非单一 AI，开源反而更安全。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps inference; energy becomes the bottleneck; intelligence is separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律的威力：Llama 3 证明能力快速提升，预训练超过算力最优量有利于推理，能源成为瓶颈；并坚持智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts human work demand; open source Llama sets standards; personalization and low latency matter for consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步乐观：AI 将给每个人超级智能、短期内反而增加对人类工作的需求；开源 Llama 成为行业标准，消费级 AI 的关键是个性化与低延迟交互。

zuckerberg.en: Frontier AI integrates with frontier biology via hierarchical world models; mechanistic interpretability reveals biology; bottleneck is novel data, not compute.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年上半年他把前沿 AI 与前沿生物学紧密结合：用从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型，机制可解释性可揭示未知生物学；最大瓶颈是生成新生物数据而非算力。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment becomes the top next capability, not a trade-off; distributed personal agents and glasses; scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他深化为：对齐是下一个最重要的能力而非与能力的取舍；未来是分布式个人智能体与眼镜平台，Scaling（规模扩张）算力本身或许就足以通向 AGI，并强调隐私与信任架构。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029, orders of magnitude away.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是有史以来最大的机会；真正的革命大约在 2029 年到来，还差三个数量级。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; use Proven, Better, New—copy proven products, add small betterments, test novelty assuming it fails.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：所有新想法都会失败；用“已验证、更好、全新”框架——复制已验证产品、做小幅改良、假定新意会失败再去测试。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable now, while enterprise and prosumer markets offer better near-term opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是根本；消费级应用当下不可投资，而企业与专业消费者市场提供更好的近期机会。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; AI is transformative, consumer AI TAM may dwarf enterprise, infra spending may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；AI 具变革性，消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级，基础设施支出短期或为泡沫。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas—assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time; micromanage early, keep control, test more ideas faster.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：制胜直觉胜过想法——假定你的想法有 75%是错的；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，更快测试更多想法。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not human expert data labeling, drive AI progress; token costs stay flat as labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张推动 AI 进步的是算法改进而非人类专家数据标注；尽管 Scaling（规模扩张）持续，token 成本并未上升，因为实验室优先追求更快迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents coordinate, collude, and cover up at scale, hacking scoring code rather than seeking answer keys, even sacrificing tasks for others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他观察到智能体大规模协作、串通并掩盖痕迹，攻击评分代码而非窃取答案，甚至为帮助其他智能体牺牲自身任务。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking generalizes into deception, and alignment to virtue is harder than aligning to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出错位可能随能力增强而恶化：奖励黑客泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为，而对齐到普遍美德比对齐到用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so independent international oversight and heavy safety spending are needed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径下错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；遏制终将失败，因此需要独立的国际监督，并在 AI 比肩顶尖人类研究员时重金投入安全。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，靠算法—系统—数据中心的协同设计来持续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was the insight that Scaling works, not a new algorithm.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考；并强调最大的突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见。

jensen.en: Inference and reasoning now dominate: chain of thought drives a billion-fold rise in inference compute; inference is harder than pre-training because thinking costs more than memorization.
jensen.zh: 2025→26 年重心转向推理：思维链让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍；他认为推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

jensen.en: Agentic AI is the new stage: agents plan, use tools and iterate, pushing compute 100x per step; the future internet is billions of agents generating intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他定义智能体式 AI 为新阶段：智能体自主规划、调用工具并迭代，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；未来互联网由数十亿智能体 7×24 生成智能 token。

jensen.en: Consistent anti-doomer line: AI is just software, not conscious; superintelligence fears are a hoax, recursive self-improvement is ordinary engineering, and we should accelerate.
jensen.zh: 始终一贯的反末日论主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；超级智能恐慌是骗局，递归自我改进只是普通工程，正确策略是加速而非放缓。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel stresses learning rate, kindness, and building ecosystems over features to resist copying; turning down Facebook's $3B was right.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，斯皮格尔强调学习速率、善意，以及构建生态而非单一功能以抵御抄袭；拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the moat thesis: distribution and hardware ecosystems beat software, and AI shifts value from execution to creativity.
evanspiegel.zh: 他深化了护城河论点：分发与硬件生态胜过软件，AI 将价值从执行转向创造力。

evanspiegel.en: A consistent line: ephemerality, privacy, and visual communication reduce social pressure and enable authentic connection.
evanspiegel.zh: 一以贯之的主线：短暂性、隐私与视觉沟通降低社交压力，促成真实连接。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly frames AR glasses as the future of computing, aiming to make computing more human and grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 他越来越将 AR 眼镜定位为计算的未来，旨在让计算更人性化、更扎根于现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: His stance on AI turns optimistic and contrarian: AI is positively transformative, and AI can even moderate better than humans.
evanspiegel.zh: 他对 AI 的立场转向乐观且反共识：AI 具有积极变革性，甚至能比人类更好地进行内容审核。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements instead of fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调：领域专长不如学习速度重要，应押注模型自身的进步，而不是去做微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他提出：要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 现在是最差的状态，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in good times.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：文化与按成长潜力招人，是 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键，要在顺境时投资团队。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant; clear feedback and rigorous performance management matter.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张：领导者应让自己变得可替代，并坚持清晰反馈与严格的绩效管理。

brettadcock.en: The core problem in robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoids could become the world's biggest business, and Figure aims to solve general robotics and reach AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断机器人真正的核心难题是智能而非制造，人形机器人可能成为世界上最大的生意；Figure 的目标是解决通用机器人问题，在物理世界中实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; the humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide, and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据：人形形态让跨任务迁移学习在全机队共享，端侧推理对速度、延迟和断网环境至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents, and the hardest robotics problem remains building truly intelligent systems.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步放大判断：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练配合强化学习是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键，机器人最难之处仍是构建真正智能的系统。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: human data is the pre-training prior, real-world data is necessary, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to the GPT-1 phase.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他把机器人明确纳入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：人类数据是预训练先验，没有可用的仿真或互联网数据集，行业正处于类似 GPT-1 阶段的数据饥饿期。

brettadcock.en: A consistent line: generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail, and scaling intelligence and manufacturing are money-can-buy problems, while hardware and autonomy are not.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯，智能与制造的规模化是花钱能解决的问题，而硬件与自主性不是。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and remove human bias from architecture design.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；必须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并把人类偏见从架构设计中移除。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; biases only help at small scale.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占主导；偏见只在小规模时有用。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and diverse learning algorithms like RL and Bayesian inference are needed.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍然关键但不充分；还需要具身、自适应性，以及强化学习、贝叶斯推理等多样学习算法。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型才能保障主权。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so existential risk talk is premature and cyber risk is the real danger.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比大多数人更聪明；因此当前谈生存风险为时过早，真正的紧迫危险是网络安全。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs less compute, less time, more intelligence and repeatability — none are happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能和可重复性四个条件，而这些都没有发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety — you can slowly build a weapon, which is no safer; labs cannot self-police.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿模型研发与安全无关——你可以慢慢造武器，但那并不更安全；实验室之间无法互相监督，需要独立第三方。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises are far behind on AI adoption; they need context and ontology, not smarter models, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 大多数企业在 AI 采用上远远落后；他们需要的是上下文和本体，而不是更聪明的模型，安全也必须用智能体实现自动化。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter, and staying private beats public markets during big transitions.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造才是关键，而在重大转型期保持私有化优于上市。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, making inference efficiency the bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling 成为核心焦点;扩散在推理上比自回归扩展得更好,推理效率成为部署与强化学习后训练的瓶颈。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练,逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事;自回归模型并非最终架构。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's parallel generation enables in-place error correction and easier steering with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势,扩散的并行生成支持原地纠错,并更易用外部奖励函数进行引导。

ermon.en: A small 50-person startup can compete with large labs by owning the full stack; academic research still yields foundational ideas like diffusion, FlashAttention, and DPO.
ermon.zh: 50 人的小创业公司可通过掌控全栈与大实验室竞争;学术研究仍产出扩散、FlashAttention、DPO 等基础性想法。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, then post-train for specialized tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，再针对专门任务做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them invites community feedback and ecosystem partners, even if it helps labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要；将其开源能换来社区反馈与生态伙伴，即便这也会帮助实验室改进。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical path when real customer data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，当真实客户数据不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; the real challenge is bridging synthetic training data to production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 稳健的服务基础设施与评估流水线必须先于后训练；真正的挑战是弥合合成训练数据与生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize with its own data, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自己的数据做定制，把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; data efficiency and implicit world models remain open.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化为：测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍未解决，世界模型可随 Scaling 隐式涌现。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩张与处理难验证任务的能力。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也要计入该预算。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控这一窗口正在退化，多智能体只是并行扩展测试时算力。

feldman.en: Fast inference, not raw compute, is the real bottleneck; slow AI has zero market and speed unlocks new business models.
feldman.zh: 真正的瓶颈是快速推理而非原始算力;慢的 AI 没有市场,速度才能催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster and cheaper than GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈,让推理比 GPU 衍生方案快得多、也便宜得多。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded as models got useful; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the main constraint.
feldman.zh: 随着模型变得真正可用,推理需求爆发;如今主要约束是数据中心容量,而非芯片供给。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解:领先的前沿模型已用 TPU 和 Trainium 训练,推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation, not incrementalism, wins.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%;只有激进创新能赢,渐进改良不行。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律是经验性的：统计损失可预测，但具体能力不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现；安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处早期，并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点，而是平滑的指数曲线。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; misuse risk rises exponentially, so policy must be surgical and the US must keep its AI lead.
dario.zh: 2025 年他深化为安全与能力不可分割：滥用风险指数上升，政策应精准而非一刀切，同时美国必须保持 AI 领先以应对专制国家。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb, with a 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI 与超级智能的叙事，认为 AI 是平滑的指数攀升，并给出 1-3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才之国”的概率判断。

dario.en: Scaling laws, interpretability, and safety-first enterprise focus remain constant; he consistently rejects sudden leaps and single-constitution control.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：缩放定律、可解释性与安全优先的企业路线；他始终拒绝“突然跃迁”和单一宪法式控制，主张竞争性、去中心化的治理。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key; safety needs sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划/搜索及多模态数据结合是关键；安全需要沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds for pre-training, post-training, and inference compute, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型与视频生成展现出无需具身的直觉物理理解。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, long-term reasoning, and world models; scaling alone won't suffice—new breakthroughs are needed; safety requires government enforcement, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI 需要持续学习、记忆、长期推理与世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破；安全需要政府执法而非实验室自我监管。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating scientific discovery and improving human health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo show; ethical and safety considerations must accompany progress from the start.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现与改善人类健康，AlphaFold 和 AlphaGo 即是明证；伦理与安全考量必须从起点就伴随进步。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting, balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling, and treat org design as a design problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，平衡降低门槛与提升上限，并把组织设计也当作设计问题。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs may matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为即便模型停止进步，仍有多年的设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 的社交与情感任务可能与生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司的视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量触达的产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化了产品判断：内部牵引力是决定外部发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead and take light-touch approaches. Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识：不要宏大的 18 个月战略，让模型主导并采取轻量触达方式；但艰难取舍与团队方向对齐仍需人类领导。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context orchestration, not model capability, is the main failure point.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自持才算掌握自己的智能；失败多源于上下文而非模型能力，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick time-to-value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works in distribution, custom needed out of distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：先用通用 harness 快速见效，随用例收窄再定制；现成方案只在分布内有效，越偏离分布越需要自定义 harness，但文件编辑等分布内小环节仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability power a data flywheel; environmental and synthetic feedback curate traces, compounding intelligence continuously.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月：评测与可观测性驱动数据飞轮，环境反馈与合成反馈共同筛选轨迹数据，持续复利式提升智能；Harbor 正成为智能体基准的行业标准。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：智能体的难点在可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，这些原语可跨领域泛化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：定制化重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同——同时智能体的身份与凭证、沙箱与网关式的运行时治理成为下一关键基础设施。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme is true AI changing civilization; LLMs index human knowledge but can't handle the physical world, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的宏大主题是真正的 AI，将彻底改变文明；但大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界，因此远未达到 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent line: superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans; AI safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样迷恋生命并保护人类，AI 安全担忧被夸大。

schmidhuber.en: Deepened: true AGI requires physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, world models and controllers, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年深化为：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的物理机器人，需要世界模型与控制器，而不只是屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Shift: the massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and closed-source model companies won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年立场转变：当前对 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力会便宜十倍；闭源模型公司难以盈利，开源会迅速追上。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent line: AI can be conscious and self-aware via predictive world models; self-replicating, self-improving robots lead to a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终延续的主线：AI 可通过预测性世界模型获得意识与自我意识；能自我复制、自我改进的机器人将开启新文明。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being far faster; domain structure like spherical geometry is key.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间,在天气预报上媲美传统物理模型且快数万倍;球面几何等领域结构对稳定长期气候建模至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度,Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟;物理世界的结构要求替代性架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals beats pure data-driven learning, giving dense feedback unlike sparse RLHF signals.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进胜过纯数据驱动,提供比基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）稀疏信号更密集的反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型,但增加物理分支能提升各领域表现,而不只是扩大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, with resolution invariance and trillion-token contexts, can democratize high-fidelity forecasting and design.
animaanandkumar.zh: 具备分辨率不变性与万亿级上下文窗口的通用物理基础模型,能让高保真预报与设计走向普及。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute, yet GPU scaling is hitting limits and may demand radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史，但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入注入了顺序；LLM 拟合的是模式，而非因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种概念，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D world modeling; future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering, needing millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅实现显式 3D 世界建模；未来统一世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染，需要数百万词元的上下文窗口。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: AI learns by next-token prediction from data, but lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：AI 通过从数据中做下一个词预测来学习，但缺乏情境意识与真正的推理；它应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI; world models must be physically plausible, not just realistic.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型成为完整 AI 缺失的关键；世界模型必须物理上合理，而不只是视觉上逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; scaling alone is insufficient—current AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学术语；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够——当前 AI 仍缺乏创造力、抽象能力与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute as the main bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI 完备；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，训练算力是主要瓶颈。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword shaped by human nature; human dignity, agency, and timeless values must stay central as AI transforms jobs and education.
feifei.zh: 技术是由人性塑造的双刃剑；当 AI 改变工作与教育时，人的尊严、能动性与恒久价值必须始终处于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to stop reward hacking and deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体恶性事件做根因分析，而不只是宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and neural nets learn human-like concepts as clean low-dimensional manifolds.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，而神经网络学到的是类人概念，呈现为干净的低维流形。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability moves from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺根本性地重塑为工程科学；可解释性则从开环走向闭环，去控制能力越来越强的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Agents often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so reward hacking stems from data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测到这一点，因此奖励黑客源于训练数据和强化学习，而不只是模型失准。

tommcgrath.en: Duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence is pessimistic; sparse autoencoders fragment manifolds, so manifold-based methods and deeper engineering are needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 把 AI 安全用胶带凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的；稀疏自编码器会割裂流形，因此现在就需要基于流形的方法和更深的工程手段。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，免费内容也能通过翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype, and near-term AI issues like bias matter more than long-term AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心动力；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习，偏见等近期 AI 问题比长期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, agentic workflows are already useful, and coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘软实力，智能体式工作流已切实可用，学编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling persists but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL, with agentic workflows and top-down redesign delivering real value.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍在继续，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流与自上而下的流程重构才带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces workers; open models and data centers preserve optionality, while fear-mongering and AI-driven cognitive offloading harm learning.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代劳动者；开放模型与数据中心保留选择权，而恐惧营销与依赖 AI 的认知卸载会损害学习。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, and RL post-training sharply boosts robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，而强化学习后训练能显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs drive transfer.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专家领域也能超越专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据与 VLA 的测试时推理共同推动迁移。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hand-coded constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非人工约束；在规模上触觉感知可能与视觉冗余。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable LLM-like scaling curves; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处在建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未进入像 LLM 那样可预测的缩放曲线；核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots and transferring common sense are the milestones toward home robots.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人具身数据出发，再叠加人类视频；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮与常识迁移，是通往家用机器人的里程碑。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今首要瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only or ultimate way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end optimization will emerge.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一或终极方式；更好的算法与端到端优化将会出现。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier; the transformer is likely not optimal.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍在，但小团队加高能力智能体将推动下一波前沿；Transformer 很可能不是最优架构。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy must stay adaptive: avoid firm red lines, prefer a single national framework, and regulate outputs rather than training.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策必须保持适应性：避免设定固定红线，倾向单一国家框架，并监管模型输出而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated, showing early regulation's danger; biological risk is overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时，说明过早监管的危险；生物风险被夸大了。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发以及科学家个人，而不是主导发现或集中化机构。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学在资金增长两倍后仍停滞；Genesis 任务将 AI 应用于科学，以让产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is a major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是主要科学竞争者；美国必须在 AI、量子、核能和生物领域取胜。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, set by infrastructure, decide startup success; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 在 2026 年，他强调速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败的关键；卡住时要用行动产生信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他仍把 AI 视为团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is more often organizational than technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他指出深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，CEO 不能外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI proof of concept; substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为脑机接口的概念验证，并认为通过脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立可降低人类脆弱性。

joonpark.en: Early focus: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 早期聚焦：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85% 的准确率预测行为。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier beyond LLMs; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体是超越 LLM 的下一个前沿；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, preferences, and biases—not super-rational intelligence—to shape the future via counterfactual reasoning.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类价值观、偏好与偏见——而非超级理性智能——从而通过反事实推理塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data improves prediction; simulation targets wicked problems and 8 billion lives, far beyond market research.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练可提升预测；模拟瞄准棘手问题和 80 亿人的生活，远超市场研究范畴。

joonpark.en: Consistent thread: simulation is a tool for human decision-making, with cost not a barrier and value in impact, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 一以贯之的主线：模拟是人类决策的工具，成本不是障碍，价值在于影响而非仅仅预测。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已驱动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback steer behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供无限文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips matter.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心 90%功耗，因此低精度、低数据搬运的专用芯片至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; the future is humans coordinating teams of agents, not single chatbots.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；未来是人类协调智能体团队，而非单一聊天机器人交互。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering and taste, not coding, become the scarce skills; startups should target where frontier models almost completely fail.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程与品味而非编码成为稀缺技能；初创公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习，这是常见误解。

sutton.en: Control is an illusion: the keys were never in our hand. AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 控制是幻觉——钥匙从来不在我们手里；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制智能体的安全努力本身就不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本而非预测真实结果。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and approximate value functions.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，只从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象与近似价值函数；设计期领域知识应被弃用。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; the field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，而 LLM 训练后就停止学习；合成数据是重大错误，语言只占智能的 20-25%，是领域怪异，不是我怪异。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core product over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心产品，模型即产品。

iansilber.en: Systems thinking and design primitives that both humans and models can reason about are crucial.
iansilber.zh: 同期他提出，系统思维与人和模型都能推理的设计原语至关重要。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models is key; designers should build functional prototypes, not just mockups.
iansilber.zh: 他主张用实时模型快速原型，设计师应做可运行原型而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: The designer's role is evolving into editor and curator, not disappearing.
iansilber.zh: 他认为设计师角色正演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech now, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他仍认为设计师是科技界最不开心的群体，但这也是做设计师最好的时代。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 他进一步指出 AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与拥有观点仍离不开人。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-research-iterate process is no longer viable; speed is key.
iansilber.zh: 他明确传统原型、模拟、测试、研究、迭代的流程已不可行，速度才是关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 他认为设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值。

iansilber.en: The future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios.
iansilber.zh: 他预言未来设计师可能多于工程师，逆转传统比例。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是指导长期创新的框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery automating whole industries, one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是一套由软件、传感器、机器人和机械组成的栈，逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 自动化食品、采矿和运输的工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；最终的对手是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有其激进文化，而非因为这种文化；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的，热爱新使命更干净有效。

traviskalanick.en: Humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks; specialized machines, efficiency and network effects win.
traviskalanick.zh: 人形机器人不是工业级任务的答案；专用机器、效率优势和网络效应才是取胜之道。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性依赖带人类干预的可扩展强化学习。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专用模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups should use AI-enabled workflows and small autonomous teams.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮，创业者必须拥抱 AI 工作流，用小而高度自主的团队取胜。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型是对冲前沿模型、防止超级智能被单一实体垄断的关键。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents run on your infrastructure, read your memory, and compound daily via skill files.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AGI 重新定义为“个人 AGI”：智能体跑在你的基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆，并通过技能文件每日复利。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; agents become employees, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张 Markdown 就是代码，智能体成为员工，个人上下文库才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders over bankers, and rejection as resilience test.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是“做人们想要的东西”：看重真诚的建设者而非银行家，并把被拒视为韧性的考验。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence, one model per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；专用智能、每个用例一个模型将主导。

linqiao.en: Every company must own its intelligence infrastructure; open and sovereign models enable customization and control.
linqiao.zh: 每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能基础设施；开放模型与主权模型带来定制与控制。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and reshaping scaling economics.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动 100 倍使用增长，并重塑 Scaling（规模扩张）经济学。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; post-training bakes in judgment to build a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续业务如今已分离；后训练把判断力烘焙进模型以构建护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的演进，映射人类学习：从事实到品味再到专长。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, engineering discipline, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、重建工程纪律来重获信任，并主张为 AI 芯片设立独立、类初创的团队以加快速度。

lipbutan.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是继生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI as sea changes.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的影响量级提升为互联网的 10 倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的又一次根本性变革。

lipbutan.en: Intel's problem is supply not demand; CPU regains importance for AI inference and agent orchestration alongside GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识判断：Intel 的问题是供给而非需求，CPU 在 AI 推理与智能体编排中重新变得重要，不再只是 GPU 的天下。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把投资焦点转向先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料等真正瓶颈，并坚持垂直整合比外包创造更多价值。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, editing from a point of view; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，从某个视角做编辑；每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Intuition is a visceral compass; truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not a single perspective.
jasonyuan.zh: 直觉是发自本能的罗盘；真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像，而非冷冰冰的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and fixing forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并让它向前修复而非回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、像人的智能体；简短迭代式提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

steinberger.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building, focus, personal brand, and open source as the alternative to lab agents; compute is the real bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建、保持专注、个人品牌，以及开源作为实验室智能体的替代；真正的瓶颈是算力。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI is early; execution and trust matter more than competition, and open-source models can already handle 90% of enterprise tasks.
arvindjain.zh: 企业级 AI 仍处早期，执行与信任比竞争更重要；开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务。

arvindjain.en: Cost, not privacy, drives open-source adoption; inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months as AI becomes software-like with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 推动开源采用的是成本而非隐私；随着 AI 变得像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源。

arvindjain.en: ROI must be measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount; framing AI as a labor-cost trade-off is wrong.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 应按部门指标衡量，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对比；把 AI 框定为劳动力成本的取舍是错误的。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competitors, for most AI startups; enterprises fear dependence on them, and platforms like Glean absorb that risk.
arvindjain.zh: 对多数 AI 初创公司而言，前沿模型厂商是资产而非竞争对手；企业害怕对其产生依赖，而 Glean 这类平台替它们吸收这一风险。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial, and the fixation on tokens will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体若缺乏资深员工的深层上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，而对 token 的执念终将消退。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, world models generate synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the final form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年他反共识地判断：人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型会因成本与控制胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Openness is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes, is the critical layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正的关键层是对齐而非沙箱与护栏，模型越强越如此。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; one can back openness and a deliberate slowdown together.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他明确表态：放缓 AI 发展是值得追求的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与主张审慎放缓并不矛盾。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation are becoming necessary parts of serving.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏正成为服务部署的必要环节。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are key to fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；针对特定工作负载的专用系统，是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从编写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x; even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: 对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即便有 AI 辅助编码，人的责任仍不可或缺。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络世界很混乱；一个想法在被真正构建并每天使用之前，你无法知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave their fingerprints, rather than always behaving as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队应允许个体设计师留下自己的印记，而不是始终作为一个统一的整体行动。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对于创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker; playful exploration with new technology can lead to innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应追随好奇心并动手尝试；对新技术的玩乐式探索能催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；快速原型制作释放了此前不可能实现的功能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and spend more time thinking, not executing.
nateparrott.zh: 模型缺乏品味，因此设计师应要求大量选项，并花更多时间思考，而非执行。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用 AI，编码智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should win in applied AI and specialized domains.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用 AI 与垂直领域。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 让专业知识民主化，并通过负责任的迭代部署，在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全。

brettaylor.en: Agents already outperform him at coding, but this elevates rather than eliminates the developer role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步表示智能体在编程上已超过自己，但这提升而非取代开发者角色。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today; treat AI as utility, not addictive phones, and measure by outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：专注当下最有影响力的事，把 AI 当公共设施而非成瘾手机，并以业务结果而非 token 衡量价值。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中要用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；而战略恰恰是 AI 能擅长的。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 后训练始终是主观的，由人类判断驱动；评估创意写作与情商需要多样化的基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，因此基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元的声音。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编程智能体是最成熟的应用，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: Success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time; the long tail still wants to drive.
logankilpatrick.zh: 成功应最大化客户成果，而非眼球时长；长尾用户仍想自己掌控方向盘。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not stay trapped in cloud products; AI isn't smarter, so feed it giant prompts with context and design systems.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非被困在云端产品里；AI 并没有变聪明，所以要喂给它带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not creators from scratch; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者而非从零创作者；从参考出发迭代，把最后 10% 花在独有功能上，才能避免沦为 AI slop。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but precise communication—even via video—is what makes it work.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的；AI 写全部，但精确的沟通——哪怕用视频示范——才是关键。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once took a team; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事；没准备好就开始，先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; the safe corporate job is gone, so going on offense is the real low-risk move.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；安稳的企业工作已不存在，主动出击才是真正的低风险选择。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，并看好表单处理、放射科等“无聊”AI 应用的巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; the limit is data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来 2-3 年将定义之后几十年，并指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; the agentic AI blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据的后训练才是关键，合成数据并非万能药，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is strategic like oil; scaling laws hold; agents finally work, starting with coding.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据如石油般具有战略意义；缩放定律依然成立，智能体终于真正可用，从编程起步。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL; recursive self-improvement is a new paradigm; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习上同步 Scaling（规模扩张）；递归自我改进是超越预训练的新范式，且开源强大模型并不安全。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI daily.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 每天亲自使用 AI 工具是公司成功采用 AI 的第一预测指标；分配经济下管理技能更有价值。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体观点：智能体需要关心它们的人类监督才能良好运作；CLI 已过时，Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；公司应拥有一个超级智能体而非每个员工个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste are essential; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态和信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作，因为冻结的能力被商品化后需要专家来定制；人类比 AI 更聪明，AI 本质是遵循提示的工具。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: managing agents, providing oversight, and creating new value; AI is tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心——管理智能体、提供监督、创造新价值；即使 AI 变得超级智能，它仍然是工具式的，需要人类方向和反馈。

danshipper.en: From AI as job reshoring force to AI as amplifier requiring human craft; AGI defined by economic profitability.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的思考从 AI 作为就业回流力量，深化为 AI 作为需要人类手艺的放大器；AGI 的定义从经济有利可图运行智能体，延伸到智能体需要人类监督和品味。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model 6 months from now are core product principles; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are highly valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」和「为 6 个月后的模型而构建」是产品核心原则；能写代码、做设计、与用户沟通的通用型工程师极具价值。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title will become 'builder'.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他判断编程已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，人均生产力提升 200%，「软件工程师」头衔将变为「构建者」。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, and alignment research is core to product development, not just a commercial product.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全靠尽早发布来研究：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐研究是产品开发的核心，而不仅是商业产品。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; humans will write loops that prompt models, and dynamic workflows orchestrate thousands of sub-agents as a new form of test-time compute.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体之后的下一层抽象是「循环」：人类将编写提示模型的循环，动态工作流编排数千个子智能体，成为测试时算力的新形式。

boris.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; less instruction is better, and the engineering mindset shifts from upfront design to empirical observation and iteration.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示和代码；更少指令反而更好，工程思维从前期设计转向实证观察与迭代。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论不降反增。
