scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈不在模型能力，而在设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的立场深化：企业采用智能体需要信任与权限而非完全自主，独立性带来模型中立。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes, and the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍，主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，丰裕时代临近。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years, and value accrues to the application layer, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样大，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，价值将归于应用层而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是目前前沿模型唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity, not a single product; usage is still shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a long-term project.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流，是长期工程。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，使智能体能执行更长程、开放式的任务；脚手架也从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use is moving from constrained environments toward more open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; it amplifies intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不只是防伤害，它通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, and the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，更好的模型未必更贵：Opus 4.5 更便宜高效，effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development, and managers must stay hands-on and ship.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者也必须保持动手、亲自交付。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to turn biology into an engineering discipline.
derya.zh: 2026 年他指出，当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），才能把生物学变成一门工程学科。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will accelerate clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized treatments will make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 2026 年他主张，患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，AI 设计的个性化疗法将让癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging will be reversed and humans may live hundreds of years.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年他预测，8 至 10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老将被逆转，人类可能活到数百岁。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为，医疗决策应几乎 100% 信任超级智能；人类唯一的生存威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑——劳动力短缺让自主化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨垂直领域的多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over years; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是用多年时间扩散到现有机器中；监管总是落后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models, more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习与神经世界模型，比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: The best PMs define the product a month out, not years, because frontier models improve too fast for long plans.
catwu.zh: 他提出最好的产品经理只定义一个月后的产品，而非数年之后，因为前沿模型进步太快，长期规划已不现实。

catwu.en: Safe AGI as a mission unifies Anthropic and enables fast cross-org decisions; automations must reach 100% reliability.
catwu.zh: 他强调安全 AGI 的使命统一了 Anthropic，使跨组织决策更快；自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不够。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of PRs.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他深化为编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注产品品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good—a codebase is a spec; with a good eval suite, new models are drop-in and humans leave the review loop.
catwu.zh: 他进一步反共识：重写如今是好事，代码库就是规格说明；有了好的评估套件，新模型可即插即用，外层改动可让人类退出代码审查循环。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确把 LLM 定性为「合理性引擎」而非「真理引擎」：可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）已遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 同年他深化批判：当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，事后补丁式检查只会叠加相关错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; truth should be a design principle from the start.
danklein.zh: 他主张可靠性必须被「架构进去」而非事后加装，真相应作为设计原则从一开始就嵌入系统。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—no 'smells' for errors—so they cannot know what they don't know.
danklein.zh: 他指出核心 LLM 缺乏元认知：错误没有「气味」，模型无法知道自己不知道什么，这与人类形成鲜明对比。

danklein.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning, search, and modularity with end-to-end optimization are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 他判断单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要推理、搜索，以及模块化与端到端优化的结合来推动下一步进展。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents are powerful but need scoping: start with one, then specialize to avoid context overload; treat them like employees with roles, access, and progressive trust.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体很强大，但必须限定范围：先从一个开始，再逐步专业化以避免上下文过载；像对待员工一样给它们角色、权限和渐进式信任。

clairevo.en: Security and alignment matter: run agents on a separate machine or virtual environment, and use soul and identity files to keep them proactive and aligned.
clairevo.zh: 安全与对齐很重要：把智能体放在独立机器或虚拟环境中运行，并用灵魂与身份文件让它们保持主动且与用户需求对齐。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping, onboarding, politeness—matter more than technical skills; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 管理技能——角色界定、入职引导、礼貌沟通——比技术技能更重要；网络对智能体不友好，所以 API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team; founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not the technology.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立严肃的事业；真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与赚来的洞察，而非技术本身。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 人的责任依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而且大语言模型不擅长第一性原理的创造力，所以新颖想法必须由人提供。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become the differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味、差异与真实观点成为关键区分点。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI for lack of judgment, skipping the grunt work that builds expertise; over-reliance, not takeover, is the biggest risk.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者因缺乏判断力而误用 AI，跳过了积累专业能力的苦活；最大风险不是 AI 接管，而是过度依赖。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting toward delegation.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，从来回对话式提示转向任务委派。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent, so experts are needed more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——令人惊叹、不透明、无法验证——且这种不透明很可能永久存在，因此专家比以往更被需要。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning needs breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and integrated research-product loops; per-team or per-user models cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习需要新突破、小模型基础设施与研产一体的闭环；相比 RAG，按团队或按用户训练模型能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks; scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务；靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率；个性化持续学习将跑在端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact only comes through clear communication, and leaders should be asked for help directly.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通产生，并鼓励直接向领导者求助。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 只是词语计算器而非类人智能，除缩放定律外还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open source AI like Llama accelerates progress and is safer because closed models leak; it strategically commoditizes complements.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他主张 Llama 等开源 AI 加速进步且更安全，因为闭源模型会泄露，开源还能战略性地商品化互补品。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses will evolve into AI glasses, inverting the app model so users express intent and AI orchestrates services.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他判断智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，颠覆应用模式，让用户表达意图、由 AI 编排服务。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; data is the font of all value.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信缩放定律与算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束，数据是一切价值的源泉。

bosworth.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; AI should maximize individuals, and open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他指出多数工作不需要前沿智能，AI 应最大化个体，开源只是商品层而非自维持生态。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and it will drive productivity booms and price deflation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，并将推动生产率繁荣与价格通缩。

andreessen.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss, not job loss, and human workers will be at a premium due to depopulation.
andreessen.zh: 工作比任务存续更久；应关注任务流失而非工作流失，且因人口减少，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而溢价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，而模型可能因快速商品化而缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观听起来更高级，但往往是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观并成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不仅是军事规模。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合，并强调自对弈与具备推理能力的神经网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 到 2023 年，他转向强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类，并指出可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈，同时警告超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and methods beyond brute compute improve reasoning per unit compute.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他持续深化对缩放定律的怀疑：推理 token 与其他方法能在单位算力下提升推理能力，规模扩张并非全部故事。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling is finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他明确宣告预训练规模扩张已近极限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要，并主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

ilya.en: Alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life; the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 到 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步提出若 AI 关怀有感知生命则对齐可能更容易，并认定 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中，安全超级智能需要无商业产品的公司。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat.
dylanfield.zh: 对既有代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升是有限的；只有 17% 的设计师把 AI 视为威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属于人类；AI 的输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first toward production.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先将通向生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死，反而比以往更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, and the Singularity is a religion for nerds.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确说 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，奇点论是极客的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire, a personal skill.
naval.zh: 2020 到 2025 年，他反复强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福是欲望的缺席，是一种可习得的个人技能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes English a programming language; AI agents commoditize pure software, shifting the moat to hardware and data.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让英语成为编程语言，AI 智能体使纯软件商品化，护城河转向硬件与独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source closes on frontier models; agency, not intelligence, is the human return.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型逼近前沿模型，人类的回报从智能转向能动性。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; verification becomes the bottleneck as generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；随着生成加速，验证成为新的瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍显不足，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 虽为开发者而建，却成为通用知识工作工具；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins; PhD not needed for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他提出每天 1%的改进可年化复合至 3700%增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率；AI 成功不必须读博士。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize, not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling; benchmarks are hackable.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板；基准测试可被操纵。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; power is bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key; build with fewer people.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：前沿在于智能体替人工作；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排是关键；用更少的人构建公司。

aravind.en: Chat advertising corrupts trust; model is not product; orchestration and agent harnesses create value; export controls may backfire; cost, not safety, is biggest problem for 24/7 agents.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他反共识：聊天广告侵蚀信任；模型不是产品；编排和智能体框架创造价值；出口管制可能适得其反；24/7 智能体的最大问题是成本而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important; ancient texts describe advanced tech; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity; education should reward questions; local AI counters narrative control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向人文视角：好奇心最重要；古籍描述先进技术；AI 取代工作但人类在好奇心中找到新目标；教育应奖励提问；本地 AI 对抗叙事控制。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型已能产出新知识。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief matter more than matching Meta dollar-for-dollar.
markchen.zh: 人才密度与使命信念比与 Meta 逐美元对拼更重要。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，而非主观领域。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis as canonical benchmarks saturate; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 随着经典基准饱和，评估陷入危机；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research, but lack taste, so humans remain needed for idea generation.
markchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）正在逼近；模型很快能端到端做研究，但缺乏品味，创意生成仍需人类。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams and solo entrepreneurs to scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让小团队和独立创业者也能以概念完整性扩张，应为未来模型能力而构建，而非当前限制。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计，认为智能体能完成用户能做的一切，而决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight with high trust; verification loops and long-horizon workflows redefine productivity.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他通过 Fable 强调可高信任地隔夜委派复杂任务，验证循环与长周期工作流重新定义生产力。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他领导 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 智能体式自主性和自我认知以增强实用性。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation rigor via train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调用训练/验证/测试集划分来保证评估严谨。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，进入后架构时代，AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection and new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not equal robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：自动化红队测试超越人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能借智能体成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: A consistent thread: rigorous evaluation, architecture-agnosticism, and safety as an explicit engineering problem.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：严谨评估、架构无关论，以及把安全当作显式工程问题而非规模扩张的自动产物。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与生成式世界模型是通向真正理解的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对单纯堆叠深度或参数，主张智能体需通过交互与因果推理学习，并强调解耦表征与世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，并把抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模视为分布外泛化的核心。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, demanding safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向警示：对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，哪怕 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，必须构建天生安全的 AI。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest Bayesian predictor, avoiding reinforcement learning, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实贝叶斯预测器，规避强化学习，并追求数学上的安全保证。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling and compute; specialized architecture mattered more than raw scale.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）和算力；专用架构比单纯扩大规模更重要。

jumper.en: AI tools like AlphaFold narrow hypothesis space and accelerate science, but do not replace scientists; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AlphaFold 等 AI 工具缩小假设空间、加速科学，但不会取代科学家；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；理解仍属于人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not just Scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 与“苦涩教训”相反，专用架构和众多中等突破而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）才是成功关键。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many small ideas, not lone genius; industry labs can produce top-tier science; AI trust will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 始终贯穿：进步来自众多小想法而非孤独天才；产业实验室能产出顶尖科学；AI 信任将像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership rests on trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms and kindness are strategic tools, not soft extras.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力建立在信任、吃自己的狗粮与使命对齐之上；作战室与善意是战略工具，而非软性附加。

fiona.en: By mid-2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的约束。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time, lightweight cycles; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时、轻量的周期；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs stay in sync with code, and technical debates are settled by generating multiple PRs.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档与代码保持同步，技术争论通过生成多个 PR 来解决。

fiona.en: Managers start as individual contributors to dogfood the product; flat teams, high agency, and accountability replace raw throughput.
fiona.zh: 管理者以个人贡献者身份起步来吃自己的狗粮；扁平团队、高能动性与高问责取代单纯产出。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone cannot capture emotional truth.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的人类需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，单靠数据无法捕捉情感真相。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer to learn from.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性、融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师，值得借鉴。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack true sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器只有传感器、没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable and intuition a data-rich guide.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合，创意技能更值钱，直觉则是信息量更大的决策指引。

murati.en: Real-world deployment, not closed-door research, is how alignment and safety actually get learned and improved.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调：对齐与安全必须在真实世界的持续部署与公开反馈中学习改进，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年她回顾：Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型在当时并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so development must stay responsible and focused on the most important problem.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此必须以负责任的方式开发，并聚焦最重要的问题。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth collaboration rather than turn-based exchanges.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年她提出新方向：交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年她深化立场：应尽可能长久地让人类留在回路中，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：把生成与验证结合成自我改进的推理引擎，并以 Lean 作为形式化基础。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just error removal but scaling brilliance, yielding performance and sample-efficiency gains over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，而是放大卓越：相比非形式化方法，它带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though they excel in algebra and struggle in combinatorics.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 非形式化模型无法通向超级智能，形式化方法不可或缺；但它在代数等结构化领域强，在组合数学等创造性领域弱。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, since statements must be grounded without solutions; human taste and intuition stay crucial.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为要在没有解的情况下为陈述建立根基；即便 AI 能证明定理，人的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Verified generation should extend beyond safety-critical niches to all AI-generated code and open collaboration, as fragmentation blocks progress.
carinahong.zh: 经验证的生成应超越安全关键的小众领域，覆盖所有 AI 生成代码与开放协作，因为生态碎片化正阻碍进步。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and uniqueness gets harder.
gustav.zh: 同年，他判断互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 应被视作乐器而非伪造，真正独特反而会变得更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuild infrastructure, expose data via APIs, and watch inference marginal costs.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，强调重建基础设施、用 API 暴露公司数据，并警惕推理边际成本对商业模式的冲击。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; users should control algorithms in plain English, not be made more addicted.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为生成式 AI 让产品走向双向对话，用户应能用自然语言控制算法，而不是被算法弄得更上瘾。

gustav.en: No single right org model; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer, and long-tenure trust enables honest, fast decisions.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，同步游泳优于分而治之，长期共事带来的信任才能支撑诚实而快速的决策。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and grounding in the physical world is necessary for true language understanding.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，语言理解必须扎根于物理世界；当时已指出当前 AI 缺乏常识，需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI—vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习提升为「智能的暗物质」，认为智能本质是预测，并明确文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉能提供更丰富的世界信息；同时提出非对比方法（如 Barlow Twins）优于对比学习。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and abstract representation planning are essential, and AGI will be a gradual, decades-long progression.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他系统批判自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，提出 JEPA 在抽象表征空间进行规划，并强调 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突发事件；同时力推开源 AI 以避免权力集中。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative JEPA architectures, with human-level intelligence within 10 years.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他进一步断言 LLM 缺乏世界模型、甚至不如家猫聪明，认为下一代 AI 突破将来自非生成式的 JEPA 架构；同时预测人类水平智能将在 10 年内实现，但需要全新方法。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI, with the next decade belonging to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他明确宣称 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型必须在抽象表征空间预测，才能实现安全、目标驱动的 AI；并预言下一个十年属于机器人技术，同时强调开源研究对全球进步至关重要。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute. Economic pressure pushes smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多收益；同时经济压力促使业界转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown. Frontier models still fail at simple tasks; reasoning is jagged. Generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数曲线；前沿模型仍会在幼儿级任务上失败，推理能力呈锯齿状，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data. Models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost productivity 5-10x via parallel work. RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘，需要仔细监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off. Near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他评价 OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢且成功的赌注；并强调系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source AI is safer via scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量与更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源 AI 通过广泛审视反而更安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with decentralized open-source models.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 要求对数据、基础设施与价值观的控制，去中心化开源模型赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents. AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits saturation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他断言模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业 AI 落地的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备终将走向皮下。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and reverence for the creative process are the real legacy; fragile ideas need gentle care.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调对创造过程的好奇与敬畏才是真正的遗产，脆弱的好想法需要被温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together matters.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思考的价值。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁要带着喜悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张设计必须创新，否则就不是设计；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI systems: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck, and batch size is the key lever trading latency against cost.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统：瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力，批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, so context window stagnation stems from memory bandwidth, not compute.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文推理受内存墙限制，因此上下文窗口的停滞源于内存带宽，而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design choices.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动设计选择的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory cost but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存的内存成本，但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; hardware primitives like systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to reduce that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存等硬件原语正是为减少这种搬运而存在。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter over hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效力取决于能否调用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的 Skills 让超个性化自动化变得容易；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，关键是把投入放在能力与安全上。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for vague ones.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，说不清需求时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks and run asynchronously; don't supervise closely, judge only by final impact, and debug the workflow with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理枯燥的后台任务并异步运行；不要紧盯监督，只看最终影响，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks, so society must discuss labor market change.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年经验压缩成数周，因此社会必须讨论劳动力市场的变化。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新，并将推理时算力视为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具使模型能超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练强化学习仍是充满潜力的绿野。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化，并认为推理时 Scaling 曲线是个“骗局”。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models now dominate openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需完全透明——数据、中间检查点与配方，而非仅权重；中国开源模型已在开放度上占据主导。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months and may not catch up.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理 Scaling；开源模型落后前沿 6 至 9 个月，且可能因资源与人才差距难以追平。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; Scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，并认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy is critical; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他转向强调合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免模型坍塌；同时认为通过蒸馏，认知核心可以小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: LLMs are a new operating system: context window as memory, prompts as programs; this is the decade of agents.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出 LLM 像新操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL for LLMs is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and a memory-stripped cognitive core is needed.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：当前面向 LLM 的强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会坍塌，需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: programming by prompting; agents handle code, but understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他提出软件 3.0 即通过提示词编程，智能体接管编码；但你可以外包思考，不能外包理解，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps, starting from solutions rather than problem statements.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程已经过时，设计师应信任直觉与手艺而非僵化步骤，甚至可以从解决方案而非问题陈述出发。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他明确宣告 AI 杀死了“研究—发散—收敛”流程：设计师画原型的时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，必须帮工程师执行、快速交付以建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months; designers must be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, with judgment over taste.
jennywen.zh: 同期他进一步提出设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月，设计师应成为“块状”通才或“开挂应届生”，判断力比品味更重要。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption pace, wait six months, keep users central, and sit with ambiguity as unique value.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他强调设计师应控制 AI 进入工作的节奏、等六个月再采用新工具，以用户为中心，并把“与模糊性共处”视为独特价值。

jennywen.en: Craft, care, and intuition consistently matter more than any process; speed and tools never replace designer judgment.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：手艺、用心与直觉始终比任何流程更重要，速度与工具永远无法替代设计师的判断。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：超越训练分布的泛化能力才是关键，而无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索——而非强化学习依赖的密集奖励——才是实现泛化的路径。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots demands sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization via modular policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他指出：要把好奇心扩展到真实机器人上，需要样本效率、动态动作空间，以及通过模块化策略实现跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization, not algorithms alone, are the bottleneck for learning in the physical world.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：物理世界学习的瓶颈在于数据与泛化，而非单纯算法。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: with no internet of robot data, pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：机器人本质是数据问题——没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠视频与仿真做预训练、再用真实数据做后训练。

pathak.en: A shift in emphasis: from curiosity-driven single-robot learning to a universal brain, where deployment—not overnight scaling—is the real challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年立场发生转变：从好奇心驱动的单机器人学习，转向通用大脑；真正的挑战是部署，而非像软件那样一夜扩张。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; give a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的内核身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in the system prompt counters over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；在系统提示中引入欧陆哲学，可避免模型过度经验主义。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, not deontology or consequentialism; as models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 这套宪法更接近德性伦理，而非义务论或后果论；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility is risky; it may generalize poorly and undermine the model's ability to make good judgment calls.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性有风险：它可能泛化不佳，并削弱模型做出良好判断的能力。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for public accountability and engagement.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化，对公共问责与公众参与至关重要。

askell.en: Treat models with respect and care given uncertainty about consciousness, to avoid breeding resentment in future advanced AI.
askell.zh: 鉴于意识问题的不确定性，应以尊重和关怀对待模型，以免在未来先进 AI 中滋生怨恨。

askell.en: AI can solve large-scale social problems by augmenting human expertise, but must empower people rather than disempower them.
askell.zh: AI 能通过增强人类专业能力来解决大规模社会问题，但必须赋能于人，而非削弱人。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐（Alignment）随系统变强愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; early governance design and measuring capabilities are bottlenecks as benchmarks lag behind.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，治理结构须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准已落后于前沿模型。

pachocki.en: AI can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules; neural networks often learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 能纯从数据学到语义而非语法规则，神经网络常带 bug 仍能学习，使静默错误难以察觉。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool for interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；思维链监控是可解释性的关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, needing new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化，模型将自主工作数天，需要可扩展监督等新范式。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is the key to unseen scenarios.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编写的规则栈，泛化能力是关键：AI 必须借助多样化数据与 世界模型 应对未见场景。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, akin to AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为 世界模型 能带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，完美的模拟器就等于解决了自动驾驶，类似 AlphaGo 的路径。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调语言集成能改善驾驶模型的表征、人机交互与内省能力。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力 与 世界模型，而基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; end-to-end was once laughed at but is now the winning approach.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他立场更鲜明：带内置传感器的大众车型将超越 Robotaxi，端到端曾遭嘲笑，如今已是胜出的路线。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据和人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力，并指出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule, and every company should train its own aligned models.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他指出不同前沿模型实验室因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司都应训练自己的对齐模型。

edwinchen.en: From data quality to medicine: human judgment remains critical as AI hallucinates; safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他从数据质量延伸到医学领域，强调 AI 会幻觉，人类判断至关重要，医学中安全必须优先于准确性。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI's biggest risk may be omission—failing to recommend actions—and RAG grounds responses for reliability.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他提出在医学中 AI 的最大风险可能是遗漏——未能推荐重要行动，而检索增强生成（RAG）能通过溯源提高可靠性。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo; the $20 price came from a Google Form, not strategy.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——它只是黑客松的研究演示；20 美元定价来自谷歌表单调查，而非战略。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and real user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日发布，以发现涌现能力和真实用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future—it's like MS-DOS; AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来——它像 MS-DOS；AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: North star shifted to long-term retention; growth = friction removal + core product + model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存；增长 = 消除摩擦 + 核心产品投入 + 模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; pricing will evolve, unlimited may end.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；定价将演变，无限套餐可能终结。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Agents should learn from YouTube video, not just teleoperation; language may emerge via deception.
nando.zh: 智能体应像人一样从 YouTube 视频学习，而非只靠遥操作数据；语言在 AI 中的涌现或许需要智能体互相欺骗。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；大模型令人兴奋，但并非全部——这一主线从 2023 延续到 2026。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们还没有解决方案——相比 2023 的乐观，这是明显的深化。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps and is not behind in AI; local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 非洲跨越了遗留差距，在 AI 上并不落后；本地语言模型可变革教育——从 2023 的普惠工具观延伸到具体地域。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, start simple, and build brand purpose across every touchpoint.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，初创公司必须先活下来，从更简单的产品做起，并把品牌使命贯穿到每一个触点上。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI models will commoditize and erode margins.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件，并预警 AI 模型将商品化、侵蚀利润。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not hype, and the word AI should be banned in product talks.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说大多数 AI 是胡扯，AI 应作为提升实用性的成分而非炒作话题，甚至主张在产品讨论中禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature categories; marketing is arbitrage; make tech fun to inspire creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确设计是成熟品类中的首要差异化因素，营销是套利，长期使命是让科技有趣以激发人类创造力。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard with long value chains; challengers must pace themselves, find marketing arbitrage, and stay user-centric.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的是，硬件因价值链长而艰难，挑战者必须把握节奏、寻找营销套利，并始终以用户为中心。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector DBs as disk—with reinforcement learning for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Simple, elegant solutions scale, unlike complex modular academic approaches; research taste is learned through PhD pain, and demos are easy but robust products are hard.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他强调简单优雅的方案才可扩展，反对学术界常见的复杂模块化路线；研究品味来自博士阶段的痛苦磨炼，做 demo 容易、做稳健产品极难。

jimfan.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning via a simple end-to-end model.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题视为机器人学的核心瓶颈：仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据是未来，用简单的端到端模型来扩展机器人学习。

jimfan.en: World models simulate robot behavior without explicit physics; system one control stays hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, with home use later.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为世界模型无需显式物理即可模拟机器人行为；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，家用则更晚。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agents are bottlenecked by reliability and feedback loops, not capability; coding leads progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体的瓶颈是可靠性与反馈回路而非能力，编码是 AI 进展的领先指标，并将推动 AI 研究加速。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands what models can do, with compute the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，更长的智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能力，而算力成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration matters more; manage fleets of agents, world models off critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他转向能力过剩论：编排比原始智能更重要，未来是管理智能体团队，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加速交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, chase ROI, and let products gain power without added complexity.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉模式、追求投入产出比，让产品在不变复杂的前提下变得更强。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code-reuse driven, not Figma libraries; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计系统是语义化、以代码复用为核心的，而非 Figma 组件库；品牌规范应是供设计师表达动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions, empowered designers, and shipping fast beat perfection and structured process.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切追求速度：清晰决策、赋权设计师、快速交付，胜过完美主义与结构化流程。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; brand narrative recruits talent, so hire diverse archetypes and give designers ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；品牌叙事用于招募人才，因此要招多元类型的人并赋予设计师自主权。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广博知识，但用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做后训练才是关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; better inference algorithms and data can let smaller models beat larger ones.
yejin.zh: 下一个词预测与人类学习方式根本错位；更好的推理算法与数据能让更小的模型在特定任务上胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越它，因此 AI 必须去探索未知知识。

yejin.en: RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves; reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning.
yejin.zh: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时拉低 pass@k；强化学习需要精细工程才能胜过监督微调。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 拥有多样合成数据与多元对齐的小语言模型可媲美前沿模型；给互联网去偏是不可能的。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, aligning on problems and guiding engineers; quality fluctuates like debt and is paid off iteratively.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，与工程师对齐问题并引导他们；质量像债务一样波动，需随技术债迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam openly without rigid structure, and use AI to fill gaps across end-to-end execution.
nadchishtie.zh: 把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作而非拘泥结构，并用 AI 填补端到端执行中的空缺。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution outperform specialists; small designer-engineer teams beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责的通才胜过专才；小型设计师-工程师团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是基本要求；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，以代码为唯一事实来源；90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The code editor is evolving into an AI-integrated environment; programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的主线是编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，编程从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，而人类始终掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models became essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, contrary to his earlier expectation of not doing model development.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他立场深化：定制模型变得不可或缺，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开它，这与他早先没打算自研模型的预期相反。

truell.en: Taste and logic design will outvalue carefulness; the AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will unfold over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张，品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎更值钱，AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，且需数十年才充分展开。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏面向长时程信用分配的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation and augmentation rather than be hard-coded, since wrong assumptions limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他持续主张先验知识应用于数据生成与增强，而非硬编码进网络，因为错误假设会限制性能。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning can sharply improve sample efficiency, and 99.9% reliability is the bar for warehouse robotics to create real value.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出无监督学习结合强化学习能大幅提升样本效率，并认为 99.9% 的可靠性是仓储机器人创造真实价值的门槛。

abbeel.en: A single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors; pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer beyond language.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他相信单个神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化；预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: The human brain's generality inspires AI, but current AI remains far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年的主线是：人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用，且好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失效。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on alignment and robustness, build skills, don't fear capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，优先技能积累，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research; evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved. Post-training alone can't align AGI; need third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI，需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; measure progress now. Biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：强调对齐方法的实证测试，现在就要衡量进展；最大风险不是错位本身，而是不确定系统到底有多对齐。

leike.en: From optimism about scalable oversight to concern over institutional failures; alignment may be easier than thought but worst-case behavior can worsen.
leike.zh: 从 2023 到 2024 年，他从对可扩展监督的乐观转向对机构失败的担忧；对齐可能比想象中容易，但最坏情况行为可能恶化。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, and by 2025 models improve generation over generation via algorithms and inference-time compute.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；到 2025 年，模型逐代提升，靠算法进步与推理时算力扩张共同驱动。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in the world are crucial for AGI; continual learning with modular components may replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 智能体式能力、强化学习与在真实世界中行动对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; coding is underhyped as it self-accelerates AI; open-source keeps pace with frontier models, and safety needs engineering safeguards.
shazeer.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）被低估；编程作为应用被低估，因为它能自我加速 AI 进展；开源模型紧跟前沿模型，安全需要工程保障与人类监督。
